name: Synthframe
tagline: Sketch a screen and get a wireframe generated from where you drew things, not just from text.

awards: Best Athena AI Agent for University Students

problem: Text-to-UI tools ignore the spatial intent in a designer's sketch.
solution: A sketchpad plus prompts feed a multimodal model that generates wireframes honouring the drawn layout, with an assistant chatbot.
demo_moment: Team-described: draw a login screen and get a matching wireframe.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Athena AI Agent for University Students” among 127 submissions.
Targets the 'spatial gap' in text-to-UI tools.

lessons: Name the gap in existing tools in two words.
